task: Write code for a workout tracking app that can import data from other fitness apps
rationale: Requires integration with multiple third-party APIs (Fitbit, Strava, Apple Health, Google Fit, etc.)
Needs data mapping and transformation logic to standardize different data formats
Demands secure OAuth authentication and token management
Involves database design to handle diverse workout data structures
Requires error handling for API failures and data inconsistencies
Need to maintain data integrity during import processes
